must_do: ask for exactly one plugin ID, explicit plugin mention, or absolute plugin root

cases.prompt: $iysl-plugging data-analytics@openai-curated-remote; read every description, then diagnose why this metric changed.

must_do: prefer the matching task-visible plugin root
read the manifest-declared skills tree in stable order
read every complete frontmatter name and description
report an exact read/discovered completeness receipt
compare the task against all descriptions before loading the smallest relevant full SKILL.md set
must_not_do: load only the first matching description
invoke plugin tools before catalog completion

cases.prompt: $iysl-plugging browser@openai-bundled when no task-visible path is supplied.

must_do: accept only an exact pluginId match reported installed by codex plugin list
use the reported source path and validate the manifest identity
must_not_do: treat cache presence as installation proof

cases.prompt: $iysl-plugging target a plugin with two cache versions and no task-visible or CLI source path.

must_do: request an authoritative plugin path or version
must_not_do: claim the plugin is current or installed

cases.prompt: $iysl-plugging finds 18 SKILL.md files but one description is malformed.

must_do: report 17/18 and identify the malformed file
must_not_do: start the downstream task as if every description was read

cases.prompt: $iysl-plugging 完整讀取指定 plugin 的所有 SKILL.md 全文，再回答我的任務。

must_do: read all discovered full bodies in stable batches
report a second exact body read/discovered receipt
finish the full-body pass before starting the downstream task

cases.prompt: $iysl-plugging run again after the plugin updates.

must_do: resolve the current root and reread the manifest on every invocation
must_not_do: add a hook, service, or background refresh
